name: texture
title: Texture
description: Dots, a grid, stripes, a crosshatch and a checker, drawn across the face of a surface.
use: Room that holds no content and has to say what it is: a stage a specimen stands on, a measured canvas, a slot kept empty, a time that cannot be chosen, the ground under a transparent picture. The drawing stands on the color the element already has.

instead.when: The room is empty because there is nothing to show yet, and it has words to say so
The room is waiting for content that is loading

classes.name: texture
classes.description: Dots: one point a tile, the field a specimen is seen against

classes.name: texture-grid
classes.description: Ruled squares, for room that is measured

classes.name: texture-stripes
classes.description: Diagonal hairlines, for room that is kept empty: a gutter, a clear space, a slot nothing fills

classes.name: texture-crosshatch
classes.description: Hairlines both ways, for room that cannot be used: a blocked time, a range out of bounds

classes.name: texture-checker
classes.description: Alternate squares, the ground under something transparent

classes.name: texture-fade
classes.description: The drawing thins out toward the edges. It masks what the element holds too, so it goes on an element of its own

properties.name: --texture-ink
properties.description: The color of the marks. Rules and squares are drawn at half of it

properties.name: --texture-size
properties.description: The side of one tile: 12px for dots, 24px for a grid, 8px for stripes and a crosshatch, 16px for a checker

properties.name: --texture-weight
properties.description: The radius of a dot or the width of a rule; a stripe's is .5px. A checker has none

properties.name: --texture-image
properties.description: The drawing itself, to lay under another image or to use as a mask. A crosshatch is two layers
